summary: The team is juggling two urgent threads: recovering locked Outlook accounts and finalizing the knowledge website redesign, while ramping up promotion for Asia Star and Intelligent China and preparing the Global Marcom work report.
summaryDetail: Right now, the most pressing issue is the Outlook account lockout—everyone must delete and re-login on all devices (including home devices) and contact JSB to confirm the backend unlock. In parallel, the knowledge website redesign is at a critical feedback stage: Joseph needs to share the HTML file, and he, Julie, and the team must meet to provide specific feedback so Joker can implement changes. On the marketing front, the team is prioritizing promotion of Asia Star and Intelligent China (with Berkeley as a third priority), and Joseph needs to draft target areas and request a detailed brief on conversion tracking, while the team audits the existing setup. Additionally, several deliverables are due for the Global Marcom work report and Custom Program page rewrite, with Ira to review and share the report with Zongchao, and Mara, Madi, and Xiao Rong to provide answers and partner information by September 21–22.
